summary: D-Wave Quantum Inc. filed an 8-K announcing it signed a non-binding Letter of Intent for $100M in proposed funding under the U.S. CHIPS and Science Act, administered by the Department of Commerce. The funding would be provided in exchange for $100M in D-Wave common stock issued to the Department, contingent on executing definitive award documents. The funds are intended to accelerate development of annealing and gate-model quantum systems at R&D facilities in Florida, Connecticut, and Canada. This is a government grant/strategic partnership, not a traditional M&A or capital markets event. Watch for definitive agreement execution and further CHIPS Act award details.
